title: Conditional κ = 0.001675809683500501: mixed T37 allocation with X54 and fusions
head: 4e392e90e3fca8f395e35d6a23644920160a9f0f
body:
This contribution composes our **globally allocated mixed T37 witness with PR1195's source-holder fusions and PR1130/1196's X54 operation**, with locally certified conditional **κ = 0.001675809683500501**. PR1207's concurrent composition claims 0.001675807682652000; our allocation leaves two rank-one idle axes instead of eighteen. Both fully replayed predecessors remain retained separately in this PR.

The construction has 125 calls of the combined D3 word and 208 calls of its four-group D4 variant. Every ordered helper width and centre/port interface is checked equal to the original allocation. Deterministic matching regenerates the same 159,840 literal whole-helper roles across 333 calls. The final profile is `{1:783552,2:169496,3:137362,4:42458,5:27306,8:2664,48:11374}`, rank mass 2,408,256 and deficit 11,840. No selected certificate changes.

**Complete local verification passed:** the clean standalone replay completed `PASS_MIXED_X54_FUSIONS_T37_COMPLETE_ADMISSION` on tested source commit `34135ca12cf36627d5ed922335e5473ef2eb68fb`. It freshly rebuilt both providers, checked all 704 columns in both orientations, every native phase edge and wrapper, all eight coded-cell leaver premises per provider, the independent physical owner map, the strict controller, full invoice and exact assembly. It rejected 114 admission, 23 controller, 12 bit-supplier, 20 fusion, eight X54, 11 entrance, eight flow, eight independent-owner and eight parent mutations. Both rational moment engines and all 47 strict outer inequalities passed. Fresh PR589/741/799 ancestry was fully rebound with source/artifact/log and fixed coverage checks.

The complete repository **`make verify` also passed (exit 0)**. Exact standalone receipts, the tested source manifest, the broad-suite receipt and its compressed log are retained under `research/mixed-x54-t37/evidence/`. Only evidence and its README pointer changed after the successful replay; all tested proof code and frozen mathematical inputs remain unchanged. Hosted CI is queued, not claimed as passing.

The final package is `research/mixed-x54-t37/`:

```sh
OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 python -B research/mixed-x54-t37/verify.py --work /tmp/mixed-x54-t37-new
```

This rebuilds the PR1195 patch from pinned PR1148, applies a checked literal X54 patch whose scalar sequences and cleanup order must independently match the mapped PR1130/1196 recipe, applies the frozen four-group frame recipe, and rebuilds both native providers. It reconstructs owners without an optimizer and runs every strict stage plus fresh PR589/741/799 ancestry. Optional `--ancestry799` reuse rechecks all source/artifact/log bindings and mandatory coverage. The dedicated workflow runs the final package and uploads evidence. All committed package archives have been checked against their exact manifests, including preservation of the upstream CRLF recipe source.

The unchanged predecessors are `research/mixed-demotions-t37/` at κ = 0.001675672695827067 and `research/mixed-fusions-t37/` at κ = 0.001675769763609769, each with complete standalone evidence.

PR1218 also reports the same final κ using this PR's global allocation and credits PR1193. Its separately submitted composition is welcome corroborating work; this PR retains its own complete fresh replay and cold-ancestry binding.

**Credit:** our added contribution is the 208-instance global mixed allocation and its independent admission/compositions. Thomas DiFiore's PR1148 supplies the joint entrances and group-627 lead. Marius-Paul Dumitrean / Claude Code's PR1195 supplies the two source-holder fusions and proof. Jeremy Kothe's PR1130 supplies X54; Chafik Boukhalfa's PR1196 supplies its joint-entrance composition. Rohan Arun's PR1207 supplies the mapped X54 recipe and base nomination, freshly rebuilt and audited here. PR1201 independently combined fusions with PR1192; PR1176/1183/1192 concurrently explored mixed-provider gap augmentation. The mixed-provider idea is not claimed as exclusive to this work.

Retain PR1111; PR864's frame model; PR1152's matching implementation; PR1129/1131's integer flow and wave order; Hao Yan/FanPUYen's PR858 geometry; PR870/1074 admission; PR795/890/942 signed prices and T37 construction; PR987/1018 scalar-word ancestry, PR1030 endpoints, PR1049 leaver checks, PR559 and the unchanged PR589 bit supplier. Exact source pins and original notices are included.

Prepared for Jeremy Diviney with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. All-size compiler, common-label/mutable-source realization, whole-call hosting, precision/tape and exact recovery, analytic transfer, PR559 recurrence correction and bit H1–H5 obligations remain. No unconditional theorem, general packing optimality, complete formalization or measured runtime gain is claimed.
limits: Metadata and source identity only. Checks require source/command/coverage review; no green-badge inference.
